name: Walker S / S1
summary: UBTECH's industrial humanoid line, aimed squarely at car factories: Walker S and S1 have run training pilots on assembly and inspection lines at BYD, Nio, Zeekr and a Foxconn plant. They established the template UBTECH then extended with the battery-swapping Walker S2 and the consumer-facing Walker C1.
notable: Multiple automaker factory pilots in China
Walker S2 performs autonomous battery hot-swaps
